age_band_interval: one simulated life table per refit (Poisson variation of the 2025 deaths included), decomposed against the observed rates
not_included_in_intervals: uncertainty of the exposure scale factor used to rebuild 2025
monte_carlo_error: columns *_mcse: standard error due to the finite number of simulations.  Interval end points: 100 resamples of whole refits (separate random stream).  p-values: analytic clustered approximation, not resampled (trendlib.two_sided_p_mcse)
decomposition_precision: contributions add up to the gap up to the finite-step residual (total_deficit against sum_of_contributions); negligible for life expectancy, up to a few thousandths of a year for the death-age quantiles
